core_obligations: Use the henselian property to lift the idempotents coming from the points of the closed fibre (proof lines 2512-2530).
Decompose the algebra into a finite product of pieces according to those idempotents (proof lines 2530-2545).
Verify that each piece satisfies the hypotheses needed later in the section, which is the assertion (proof lines 2545-2550).
proof_roadmap: Lift the idempotents of the closed fibre (proof lines 2512-2530).
Decompose the algebra into a product (proof lines 2530-2545).
Check the properties of the pieces and conclude (proof lines 2545-2550).
difficulty_reason: The lemma is a preparatory statement about a finite type algebra over a henselian pair whose closed fibre is quasi-finite, and the proof is a 39-line argument combining the lifting of idempotents along the pair with the decomposition of the algebra into a finite product. It produces a factorisation of the algebra into pieces over which the quasi-finiteness can be read off, and it verifies that the pieces satisfy the hypotheses of the following statements of the section. The idempotent lifting and the product decomposition are both carried out explicitly.
